title: Concept: Conan requirement declared with a version range
description: conanfile.txt declares a requirement whose version is a range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The range resolves against the remote at install time, so two installs of the same file can compile different libraries.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through conanfile.txt (conan).
risk: The range resolves against the remote at install time, so two installs of the same file can compile different libraries.
